name: d3-scale-chromatic · Sequential schemes

title.zh: d3-scale-chromatic · 拿走配好比例尺的分类顺序发散

description.zh: 看Sequential页的Viridis等渐变条，验证连续插值器的真实渲染。 d3-scale-chromatic 是 D3 的配色模块文档，提供顺序、发散、分类、循环四类配色，离散色板与连续插值器可配合 scaleOrdinal 和 scaleSequential 使用，大多源自 ColorBrewer。模块代码为 ISC 许可，ColorBrewer 软件与配色另按 Apache-2.0 许可。
description.en: d3-scale-chromatic is the D3 color module documentation offering sequential, diverging, categorical, and cyclical palettes, with discrete schemes and continuous interpolators for use with scaleOrdinal and scaleSequential, mostly derived from ColorBrewer. Module code is under ISC, while ColorBrewer software and schemes are under Apache-2.0.
